g.text: Looking east · north at left · vertical dimensions to ROOF UNDERSIDE · conceptual member elevations

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Datum: loft floor = 8′ 11¼″ above ground. Roof underside starts at T-SO top = 8′ 10½″; it rises to 10′ 0″ above loft floor.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: ALL beam and truss bottoms = wall top, 8′ 2½″. Columns carry the loads; existing walls are not assigned new gravity load.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Trial beam depths: T-SO / B2 / B3 = 8 in. T-S and T1 extend from wall-top datum to roof underside. Loft floor is ¾ in above the 8-in beams. Roof band = 8 in, provisional.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #869298

g.text: Longitudinal T-W / T-E and B-WO are outside this interior cut; their BOTTOM edges share the same wall-top datum. Depths remain to be designed.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #869298

g.text: Hip cap: 18-in rise above eaves, 8-in overhang and fascia; rear ceiling datum unchanged. North wall edge = 255 in; cap eave = 263 in.
